title: Probe local service and contract ports concurrently
goal: On Windows a loopback connect to a port nobody holds is refused only after SYN retries (measured 2,045 ms), so each down port costs the full probe timeout. Probe the five leaf-service ports (service_table::status) and the four contract endpoints (susi os) concurrently. Measured with a stopped host: susi services 1,469 -> 465 ms, susi os 2,328 -> 620 ms.
